question: What are the exact Apple localized errorDescription strings for each TranslationError static case on iPhoneOS 26.1?
reason: Pinned graphs declare the properties but not catalog copy; this port uses process-local English and does not claim Apple localization.

question: On Apple, does status(for:to:) throw unableToIdentifyLanguage for every string when LID fails, including long nonempty text, or only below a length/confidence threshold?
reason: Linux has no identification model; every status(for:to:) call throws unableToIdentifyLanguage.

question: On Apple, does translate(_:) of nonempty text ever succeed without a previously prepared/downloaded language pack, or does it always fail with notInstalled first when canRequestDownloads is false?
reason: This port never invents targetText; nonempty translate on a mixed-language pair throws notInstalled.

question: Does Configuration.== include version, and does invalidate() increment version by 1 versus assigning a new identity token?
reason: Docs say version is the value equals uses to represent change; the graph does not record the numeric policy. This port starts at 0 and increments by 1.

question: Does Apple treat zh-Hans and zh-Hant as an unsupported same-language pairing (languageCode zh) or as a supported cross-script pairing?
reason: This port treats matching languageCode+script as the same pairing (en-US/en-GB) and distinct scripts as a different pair that still fail-closes with notInstalled.

question: What is the SwiftUI translationTask lifecycle when configuration is nil versus a value whose version changed?
reason: The overlay requires SwiftUI, which this Foundation-only seed does not import.

question: When canRequestDownloads is true on Apple, does prepareTranslation() present a system download UI, throw, or return and fill isReady later?
reason: Linux cannot request Apple model downloads; canRequestDownloads is false and prepareTranslation throws notInstalled or unsupportedLanguagePairing.

question: Is whitespace-only source text nothingToTranslate or a real translation of spaces?
reason: This port treats only isEmpty as nothingToTranslate; whitespace-only strings still fail closed with notInstalled or pairing errors.
